meta.desc.home.en: Harry OneZion — AI & Data Science at HKU. A portfolio, a project index and a generated CV: small, complete tools, each with a URL or a repository behind it.
meta.desc.home.zh-Hant: Harry OneZion——港大人工智能與數據科學。作品集、項目索引與自動生成的履歷：每件小而完整的工具，背後都有一條網址或一個倉庫。

meta.desc.cv.en: The CV of Harry OneZion: education at HKU, WeWrites, selected work and skills, in English, Traditional and Simplified Chinese.
meta.desc.cv.zh-Hant: Harry OneZion 的履歷：港大教育背景、WeWrites、部分作品與技能，提供英文、繁體及簡體中文。

meta.desc.projects.en: Every project Harry OneZion has shipped or built for himself — each with a URL, a repository, or an honest note that it runs locally only.
meta.desc.projects.zh-Hant: Harry OneZion 交付過或自己做的每一個項目——每項都附網址、倉庫，或誠實註明只在本地運行。

meta.desc.hire.en: Fixed-price spreadsheet cleanup, PDF-to-Excel, invoice folders, MCP servers, scrapers and AI workflows. Price and acceptance written before the job starts: HK$380–1,800.
meta.desc.hire.zh-Hant: 定價的表格整理、PDF 轉 Excel、單據檔案、MCP 伺服器、網站爬蟲與 AI 工作流。開工前先寫清價錢與驗收：HK$380–1,800。

meta.desc.404.en: This page does not exist. The work is still here.
meta.desc.404.zh-Hant: 這一頁不存在。作品還在。

home.hireBody.en: A spreadsheet to clean, a pile of PDFs to turn into rows, a folder you redo every month — or an MCP server, a scraper, an AI workflow. Fixed price and a written acceptance test before I start.
home.hireBody.zh-Hant: 要整理的表格、要變成一行行資料的一批 PDF、每個月重做一次的目錄；再往外一點，是 MCP 伺服器、網站爬蟲、AI 工作流。開工前先有定價與寫清的驗收標準。

cv.lede.en: A short record: where I study, what I run, and the work behind the projects on this site. The printable version is A4 and stays legible in black and white.
cv.lede.zh-Hant: 一份簡短的紀錄：在哪裏讀書、在經營甚麼，以及這個網站上各項目背後的工作。可列印版本為 A4，黑白輸出仍然清楚。

cv.note.en: Use the browser's print dialog to save as PDF. The sheet is set to A4.
cv.note.zh-Hant: 用瀏覽器的列印功能存成 PDF。版面已設為 A4。

projects.lede.en: Everything I have built that I can point at. Each entry has a URL, a repository, or an honest note that it only runs on my machine.
projects.lede.zh-Hant: 我指得出來的每一件作品。每項都附網址、倉庫，或誠實註明只在我自己的機器上運行。

projects.privateNote.en: Local-only work is listed without a public link.
projects.privateNote.zh-Hant: 只在本地運行的作品，不附公開連結。

video.note.en: Click to play. Loops, no autoplay.
video.note.zh-Hant: 點擊播放。循環放映，不自動播放。

contacts.note.zh-Hant: 可以寫電郵，也可以在這些地方找到我。

footer.built.en: Built from data/ — no framework, no analytics, no cookies.
footer.built.zh-Hant: 由 data/ 生成——沒有框架、沒有分析、沒有 cookie。

footer.translation.zh-Hans: 两个中文版本分开写：繁体给香港，简体用普通话。不同的不只是字形，措辞也不同。
